notes:
Independent reader: GPT-6 Astra Pro. A reasoning-effort setting was not independently exposed to this reader; no numeric effort value is asserted. Only the authorized packet, conventions, preamble, notation snapshot and three named images were consulted. No OCR, external research, other pages or other readers were used.

The whole image is 1676 by 2360 pixels. The whole image and then each supplied half were viewed once; the lower half begins at original y=1100. Sixteen distinct necessary enhanced crops were then viewed once each. Their original boxes, enhancement operations and the one rotation are recorded in crop_manifest.json. Findings boxes use the original whole image.

The upper block continues a geometric-realization discussion and gives a rectilinear-realization proposition, two general-position conditions and an existence statement. The lower block defines connectivity, notes decomposition into disjoint connected graphs, introduces polygonal graphs/contours with degree 2, mentions duality, and states a classification by cardinality. There are two underlined Prop labels, an underlined NB and an underlined contour; multi is circled. No date or authorial page number is visible. The archive foliation 4 is preserved only as a comment.

All thirteen C doubt occurrences have a disposition. Three are resolved from the halves: the headless hook-and-shaft, f, and Dualité. Other doubts are retained, with reordered alternatives where the ink favours a different first reading. The final pencil sss/ssi shorthand receives a new doubt. The possible question mark above l in prolonge is the only possible authorial doubt sign noted; no authorial doubt word is present.

The top margin drawing is compared with H_drawings/01-4.tex, not treated as omitted from H. Its lower oval is open, and a small detached dark stroke lies below it; these features are retained without assigning them graph-theoretic status. The other margin drawing is the curved arrow from NB to Graphe.

S.json is empty, so there are no sweep rows to confirm or overturn. H uncertainty removed with unchanged wording is not counted as a substantive difference. H bold number-field macros, alternate encodings of an otherwise identical headed hook, and empty-set variants are treated as notation equivalents. The two limited mathematical checks below were actually reasoned through; the existence and classification propositions themselves were read, not proved.

checks.statement: For distinct x,y in S, overline xy intersect S = {x,y} is equivalent to no three distinct points of S being collinear.
checks.reasoning: If three distinct points are collinear, one lies between the other two and hence lies in their joining segment. Conversely, an extra point on a segment gives three distinct collinear points.
checks.outcome: The penciled i.e. explanation is consistent with the universal pair condition. This check did not decide any handwriting.

checks.statement: Within 2 <= c <= aleph_0, c != 2 is equivalent to c >= 3.
checks.reasoning: Every cardinal at least 2 is either 2 or at least the next finite cardinal 3; the infinite possibility also satisfies the latter inequality.
checks.outcome: The final i.e. comparison is consistent. The connected-contour classification itself was not proved or independently checked.
